title: [SEC2] memchr_inv _pad validation delayed until after ikm_fd processing
description: src/cdev/crypto2dev_fd.c:1829 checks the _pad field for nonzero values, but this validation happens AFTER expensive ikm_fd extraction work (fget, lock, memcpy). If _pad is corrupt, the caller has allocated 64 bytes, acquired a lock, and copied key material unnecessarily. Improvement: move the memchr_inv check before the ikm_fd block (before line 1773) to fail fast on UAPI violations.
